offset.description: Index of the first item to return

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return

tools.name: status
tools.description: Report the open file and analysis state

tools.name: open_file
tools.description: Open a file for analysis, replacing the current one. Only files inside the configured allowed directories can be opened.

path.description: Absolute path of the file to open

tools.name: list_segments
tools.description: List the segments of the open file: address range, size in bytes, permissions and name.

tools.name: list_mappings
tools.description: List how the input file is mapped in memory: file offset, address range and size of each mapping.

tools.name: list_functions
tools.description: List the functions found by the analysis, sorted by address. Supports filtering by name and paging.

filter.description: Only functions whose name contains this text (case-insensitive)

tools.name: list_externals
tools.description: List imported and exported symbols with their module. Supports filtering by name and paging.

filter.description: Only symbols whose name contains this text (case-insensitive)

tools.name: list_symbols
tools.description: List named items with their kind, and their type when known. Supports filtering by name and paging.

kind.description: Only symbols of this kind: data is typed data such as strings and variables, name is a plain label

filter.description: Only symbols whose name contains this text (case-insensitive)

tools.name: list_strings
tools.description: List the strings found in the binary with their text. Supports filtering by content and paging.

tools.name: list_types
tools.description: List the type names that set_type accepts, with kind and size. Supports filtering and paging.

filter.description: Only types whose name contains this text (case-insensitive)

tools.name: get_name
tools.description: Describe an address: its name, or the function it falls inside, plus its segment and import/export status.

address.description: Hex address like 0x401000, or a symbol name

tools.name: get_address
tools.description: Find the address of a symbol by its exact name.

name.description: Exact symbol name, e.g. WndProc or sub_401000

tools.name: get_function
tools.description: Disassemble a whole function, one line per instruction or label, with addresses, resolved names and comments. Numbers carry their radix: 0x hex, 0o octal, 0b binary, bare is decimal. Supports paging by line.

address.description: Any address inside the function, or its name

tools.name: get_item
tools.description: Show the single item at an address as the listing does: an instruction, or a data item such as a string or a variable, with its size, bytes and the function it's in. An address inside an item shows the whole item.

address.description: Hex address like 0x401000, or a symbol name

tools.name: list_xrefs_to
tools.description: List the places that reference an address (who calls this function, who reads this variable), with the function each one is in. Supports paging.

address.description: Hex address like 0x401000, or a symbol name

kind.description: Only references of this kind; call finds the callers of a function

filter.description: Only references from functions whose name contains this text (case-insensitive)

tools.name: list_xrefs_from
tools.description: List what a single instruction or data item references: call and jump targets, data it reads, writes or takes the address of. Supports paging.

address.description: Hex address of an instruction or data item, or a symbol name

filter.description: Only references to targets whose name contains this text (case-insensitive)

tools.name: list_callees
tools.description: List every call made by a function, one row per call site, with direct or indirect. Supports filtering by target name and paging.

address.description: Any address inside the function, or its name

filter.description: Only calls to targets whose name contains this text (case-insensitive)

tools.name: list_callers
tools.description: List every call to a function, one row per call site, with the calling function. Includes indirect calls. Supports filtering by caller name and paging.

address.description: Any address inside the function, or its name

filter.description: Only calls from functions whose name contains this text (case-insensitive)

tools.name: get_bytes
tools.description: Read raw bytes as a hex dump.

address.description: Hex address like 0x401000, or a symbol name

tools.name: get_data
tools.description: Read typed values: integers of a given size and byte order, LEB128, pointers with their target name, or a string. Stops early at unreadable memory.

address.description: Hex address like 0x401000, or a symbol name

format.description: How to read: fixed-size integers, LEB128, a pointer (code_ptr for function pointers) or a NUL-terminated string

tools.name: patch_bytes
tools.description: Change bytes in the analyzed program. Recorded as a patch, the analysis is updated, the original bytes are returned so it can be undone. The input file isn't modified.

address.description: Hex address like 0x401000, or a symbol name

tools.name: patch_data
tools.description: Write an integer of a given size and byte order, as a patch. Returns the original bytes.

address.description: Hex address like 0x401000, or a symbol name

format.description: Size and byte order of the value

value.description: Decimal, negative or hex with 0x, e.g. 4660, -1 or 0x1234

tools.name: patch_instruction
tools.description: Replace an instruction by assembling new text, as a patch. Only for processors that can assemble.

address.description: Hex address of the instruction to replace, or a symbol name

instruction.description: Assembly in the processor's syntax, e.g. "nop" or "jmp 0x401000"

fill_nops.description: Pad with NOPs when shorter than the original instruction

tools.name: rename
tools.description: Give an address a name, or remove the one it has. Fails if another address already has that name.

address.description: Hex address like 0x401000, or the current name

name.description: New name: letters, digits and _ $ @ ? . : ; empty removes the name

tools.name: set_comment
tools.description: Set or remove the comment at an address.

address.description: Hex address like 0x401000, or a symbol name

text.description: Comment text; empty removes the comment

placement.description: On the same line, or as lines before or after the item

tools.name: set_type
tools.description: Mark an address as data of a type, e.g. a string, an integer array or a struct, or type the function there. Refuses to turn code into data unless forced.

address.description: Hex address like 0x401000, or a symbol name

type.description: A type from list_types, optionally a pointer and/or array: u32, char[16], u8*, u8*[4]. A function type types the function there
